requests.title: Improve Subsystem Documentation
requests.rationale: Undocumented subsystems slow onboarding and increase the risk of duplicated or conflicting work as the codebase grows. Derived from: opaque-subsystems:2-of-4-subsystems-have-no-technology-attributed-to-them-specifically-packages-shared-packages-utils-responsibilities-or-dependencies-may-be-undeclared-at-the-module-level.
requests.goal: Improve Subsystem Documentation -- Reduces onboarding friction and clarifies subsystem ownership and responsibilities.
requests.expectedImpact: Reduces onboarding friction and clarifies subsystem ownership and responsibilities.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Resolved: 2 of 4 subsystems have no technology attributed to them specifically (packages/shared, packages/utils) -- responsibilities or dependencies may be undeclared at the module level.

constraints.description: No AI/LLM-generated code -- implementation must be deterministic and human-reviewable.
Documentation only -- must not change any code behavior.

requests.title: Increase Test Coverage
requests.rationale: Untested code -- especially an exposed API surface -- carries a materially higher risk of undetected regressions. Derived from: untested-api-surface:an-api-framework-express-is-in-use-with-no-automated-testing-framework-detected-untested-api-surface-is-a-higher-risk-gap-than-untested-code-in-general.
requests.goal: Increase Test Coverage -- Reduces the risk of undetected regressions and makes future changes safer to make.
requests.expectedImpact: Reduces the risk of undetected regressions and makes future changes safer to make.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Resolved: An API framework (Express) is in use with no automated testing framework detected -- untested API surface is a higher-risk gap than untested code in general.

constraints.description: No AI/LLM-generated code -- implementation must be deterministic and human-reviewable.
Tests only -- must not change existing production code behavior.
